Host routes queued slots directly to air_ops_launch_start_006c7490. It has no native block+7Ch session router or current game/selected-slot owner required by the existing 0075B430 base constructor; constructing a message with fabricated owner fields would not preserve the contract.

006C6540 needs the ready-plane list at block+D8h/DC, held-plane +38h and observer owner +24h, populated by the native ready-plane enqueue path. AirOpsDeck tracks semantic slots and launched squadrons and does not produce that ready-plane/observer graph; the host explicitly says this sub-update is not run.

006C77E0 compacts native 14h queue records at block+A8h/ACh and uses the block+8h lock and real entity flag bytes. The script host does not run that sub-update or produce the native queue records/lock owner. An empty invented queue would perform no replacement work.

Typed-view extraction requires src/cc13_seg47.cpp, an explicitly excluded active worker file. The body also needs the real plane+4A4h elevator/attachment owner; the script host's registry rows do not own that native elevator graph.

The raw body traverses the squadron's native +3D0h members, leader +C24h, target+538h class and first-slot weapon descriptors through Cc15Seg48Host. This host uses semantic squadron/ordnance facts through AttackCommandHost; that full raw callback interface and native graph are not a small adapter. Do not replace them with projected constants.

Full unit SEntityInit is a 40-callee native unit/property-holder/traffic/weapon-director init path. SetShipMaxSpeed owns a semantic max-speed update, not the native unit/class/holder and effect owners needed by Cc13BigB1Host; copying only max speed would omit the body's other effects.
Requires game+21A0h scoring storage and the actual entity+1ACh slot producer. The host explicitly does not model that index/counter, so no authentic counter cell can be built for this call.

Requires entity+C0h tagged holder, scene property bag, hierarchy matrices and Lua reader graph. The script host's semantic entity descriptors do not supply that canonical holder or hierarchy producer.

Body drains/rebuilds the native pending init list at 00F899D0/D4 and calls SEntity_InitAll. The host method is a record-only stub and owns neither that pending-list producer nor the native entity lifecycle graph. Calling with a fake entity or an invented empty list would not replace its logic.

Existing body requires the entity's canonical NativeString at +178h and actual published world+1A0Ch Lua owner. This host derives semantic keys and owns a separate Lua state view; it does not publish that native world/string owner. No substitute singleton constructed.

Factory requires a real native bot and owned 520h task constructed by 009BCE50; this script caller already delegates installation through bot_install_command_task_0099a170 and the units host owns task state. Its raw implementation is also in excluded src/cc13_seg67b.cpp; a second creation here would duplicate the existing call.
Body only reads the dword at +0Ch. Writing argument_count_ into temporary native storage and reading it back would only return the host's own value, which the counting rule excludes.

The referenced image site 0082643B is the sinking-state terrain-bit clear, not this method's 0092BD00/00C48020 mask store. The script host has no real Dyn shape+30h mask, body+4h manifold owner or world critical section; inventing a no-op clear-manifolds adapter would omit effects.
